findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_receipt, x402_diagnose · Private data: x402_trust_record, x402_trust_add, x402_preflight, x402_delivery_check · Public sink: verify_receipt · Destructive: x402_diagnose, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_receipt, x402_diagnose · Private data: x402_trust_record, x402_trust_add, x402_preflight, x402_delivery_check · Public sink: verify_receipt · Destructive: x402_diagnose, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "x402_diagnose" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
